findings.title: 95 published prediction texts use internal vocabulary the brief bans
findings.detail: The brief forbids the words 'model' and 'verified' in reader-facing predictions. These entries are live prose on other desks and were not edited by this session because each file belongs to a different session's scope. Files and line numbers are listed so the owning session can fix them.
findings.action: Left untouched by this session; listed for the owning sessions.

findings.title: Data files inside the 15-sport desks still carry Aussie Rules and eSports rows
findings.detail: Seven desks that describe themselves as exact-15-sport layers publish rows for sports that are not in the brief's list. The rows are in committed JSON, so the claim and the data disagree on the same branch.
findings.action: Reported, not edited: these files belong to merged sessions.

findings.title: The 'future-only' desk still publishes lines and picks on started fixtures
findings.detail: PR #194 announced that only fixtures with a confirmed start after the capture cut-off receive an actionable market. Re-scanning the committed data at 2026-10-24T17:35:00Z finds 17 fixtures whose published start time has already passed, carrying 212 originated selections and 20 picks. A pick on a game that has already started cannot be placed.
findings.action: Reported for the Zenith owner; this desk filters on start time instead.

findings.title: Merge-conflict markers are still checked in to the shared task board
findings.detail: COORDINATION.md carries 8 conflict-marker lines. They are plain text so nothing breaks, but the board is the coordination contract for parallel sessions and the markers make its history ambiguous.
findings.action: Left in place; this session appends only.

findings.title: A published audit finding describes a root page that has since changed
findings.detail: The /ledger/ audit's RR-03 states the root status stripe reads 2026-10-22 08:15 UTC. The committed root page now reads 2026-10-23T20:10:00Z. The finding is stale in its own text even though the page it criticises has been rewritten.
findings.action: Reported; the ledger layer is regenerated by its owner's script, not by hand.

findings.title: 47 separate dashboards publish an overlapping 15-sport brief
findings.detail: Each directory publishes its own dashboard with its own counts. A reader landing on any one of them sees a different total for the same day. This desk adds /clarity/ as an explicitly dated 2026-10-24 snapshot and states its counts on every page header rather than implying it supersedes the others.
findings.action: Root integration request recorded in COORDINATION.md.

findings.title: OLBG renders fixture times in US Eastern, not UK time
findings.detail: Confirmed again on 2026-10-24: OLBG lists HBW Balingen-Weilstetten v MT Melsungen at 'Today 14:00', while the German league publishes 20:00 CEST. 14:00 ET is 20:00 CEST. Any row that mixes an OLBG time with a governing-body time without conversion is six hours out.
findings.action: This desk publishes governing-body times and never converts from OLBG.
